headline: MSCI Upgrades BNI's ESG Rating to AA, Affirms Commitment to Sustainability
summary: MSCI raised PT Bank Negara Indonesia's ESG rating from A to AA. The bank said the upgrade reflects its commitment to sustainability in business strategy and operations.
why: MSCI ESG ratings are used by many institutional investors when screening stocks, so changes can affect index and fund inclusion decisions.
original_headline: MSCI Naikkan ESG Rating BNI Jadi AA, Tegaskan Komitmen Keberlanjutan
